# Lab fixture cleanup — 2026-09-28

**MEASURED:** the disposable September 24–28 fixtures are removed from both VMs.
Recreate the fixtures before another live run. Source files, built images and
earlier evidence remain available.

[Evidence and checksums](../../SOURCES.md#lab-fixture-cleanup-2026-09-28).
Docker and Kubernetes report resource state. Kernel process memory supplies the
parser-pad check. Loader status is a SELF witness. The cleanup driver checks these
records; it is not a traffic test.

## Removed resources

**Latest reuse:** the separate collector-container fixture was removed after its
nine-file archive was checked. The archive includes the ten-event SQLite journal.
The two test consumer containers were removed by the live runner. Cleanup then
rechecked the pinned process/binary, restored method hook and all 12 inactive slots.
It removed TMM, fixture and collector containers, plus project networks and volumes.
Other Docker identities and state stayed unchanged.
[Separate-container receipts](../../SOURCES.md#separate-collector-container-2026-09-28).

**Earlier reuse:** the continuous collector fixture was also removed on this date.
Its eight-file archive includes the ten-event SQLite journal. Cleanup rechecked
the pinned process/binary, restored method hook and all 12 inactive slots. Other
Docker identities and state stayed unchanged.
[Collector receipts](../../SOURCES.md#continuous-metadata-collector-2026-09-28).

| VM | Removed | Final check |
|---|---|---|
| Build, `10.145.37.36` | Projects `eob-config-20260925`, `eob-template-20260925` and `eob-dlp-20260924`: six containers, six networks and ten volumes | No project containers, networks or volumes remain. The final process scan finds no TMM or matching test process. The toolchain container has the same identity and state. |
| Deployment, `10.145.40.193` | `kind-vs/default`: `ai-traffic` ConfigMap, pool and virtual server; `ai-traffic-client` and `ai-traffic-backend` pods | No jig-owned resource remains. The four cluster-node containers retain their identities and state. Other `default` pods retain their identities, readiness and restart counts. Other pools and virtual servers retain their UIDs and specifications. |

All loaded programs in the checked TMMs were already disabled. Empty slots can
report monitor mode; retained disabled programs can report `armed=1 mode=0`.
Neither value alone proves attachment. The driver also checked the parser's
five original NOP bytes at `0xccc604`, after matching the executing binary hash.

The shared `kind-vs` TMM retained its process start time, executable hash and pod
identity. Its restart count stayed zero. Its loader status and parser pad were
unchanged. The older `kind-datkube` TMM was outside this probe check.

## Evidence retained before removal

Each archive is in `evidence/cache/`. Every regular file was checked against a
SHA-256 manifest read from the source volume before removal.

| Archive | Files |
|---|---:|
| `eob-config-20260925-evidence-20260928.tar.gz` | 39 |
| `eob-template-20260925-evidence-20260928.tar.gz` | 113 |
| `eob-dlp-20260924-evidence-20260928.tar.gz` | 25 |

The 177 files include failed runs. The deployment receipt also contains the
backend's final log. Existing source and evidence directories remain on both VMs.
Temporary image archives were inventoried and retained as build inputs.

## Stopped attempts and corrections

1. Build attempt 01 and deployment attempt 01 stopped before deletion. The driver
   tried to read `/usr/share/ls/hook-index.tsv`. These deployed images do not have
   that file. The corrected driver uses the recorded parser address and requires
   a matching executing-binary hash before reading process memory.
2. Build attempt 02 archived two evidence volumes, then stopped before deletion.
   The old DLP Compose file differs from the current file. It has fixed fixture
   addresses instead of variable-based addresses. The file was inspected. Its
   exact checksum is accepted only for that project and path.
3. Deployment attempt 02 and build attempt 03 completed. The build retry reused
   the two existing archives only after checking every file against a fresh
   source manifest. It then archived the third volume before removing any project.

`ask` returned NO RECORD for the initial cleanup query and both error strings.
The resolutions are now in [SYMPTOMS.md](../../SYMPTOMS.md#lab-cleanup).

## Reuse

The cached `vm-cleanup-driver-20260928.py` is a record of this cleanup. It contains
fixed project names and binary hashes. It is not a general VM cleanup tool.
Each JSON receipt contains the exact driver source and its checksum.

To restore the deployment jig, follow [README.md](README.md), starting with the
prerequisites and `jig.py up`. The old instruction to use the running jig is
superseded by this cleanup. Recreate the isolated Compose projects before running
the configuration, tutorial or parser-scope suites.
